```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

Clear Global Environment

```{r clear global environment}
rm(list = ls(all.names = TRUE)) 
```

Read in file with path to ilovedata channel on Teams Ensure that your
credentials directory is correctly located

```{r Read in paths file}
source(file = "credentials/paths.R")
```

## Load packages

```{r Load packages}
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(patchwork)
```

## Set current date

```{r current date}
date <- Sys.Date()
date <- "2025-10-16"
```

## Load data

```{r Load data sexual orientation}
dat_sex <- read_rds(
  file =
    paste0(filepath_cleaned_data,"dat_after_exclusion_sexual_orientation", date, ".rds")
)
```

```{r Load data gender}
dat_gender <- read_rds(
  file =
    paste0(filepath_cleaned_data,"dat_after_exclusion_gender", date, ".rds")
)
```

```{r Load data PRS}
#disorders
dat_prs_bmi <- read.table(filepath_prs_bmi, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
dat_prs_depression <- read.table(filepath_prs_depression, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
dat_prs_anxiety <- read.table(filepath_prs_anxiety, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
dat_prs_an <- read.table(filepath_prs_an, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
dat_prs_bipolar <- read.table(filepath_prs_bipolar, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
dat_prs_ptsd <- read.table(filepath_prs_ptsd, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
#scz
dat_megaprs_scz <- read.table(filepath_MegaPRS_scz, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
dat_SBayesRC_scz <- read.table(filepath_SBayesRC_scz, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
dat_PRSCS_scz <- read.table(filepath_PRSCS_scz, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
#sexual orientation
dat_prs_same_sex <- read.table(filepath_prs_same_sex, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```

```{r data principal componance}
dat_prs_pc <- read.table(filepath_prs_pc, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
dat_prs_pc_subset <- dat_prs_pc[, c("FID", "batch", "pc1", "pc2", "pc3", "pc4", "pc5", "pc6")]
```


```{r regression}
merged_same_sex_so$residuals_score <- residuals(model_same_sex_so)
```

```{r multinomiale logistische Regression}
## Pakete
library(nnet)
library(lmtest)
library(pscl)

# Outcome als Faktor (falls nötig)
merged_same_sex_so$sexual_orientation <- factor(merged_same_sex_so$sexual_orientation)

# Hauptmodell: PRS + PCs + Batch
model <- multinom(
  sexual_orientation ~ residuals_score +
                       pc1 + pc2 + pc3 + pc4 + pc5 + pc6 +
                       batch,
  data = merged_same_sex_so
)

# Zusammenfassung
summary(model)

# z- und p-Werte
z_vals <- summary(model)$coefficients / summary(model)$standard.errors
p_vals <- 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(z_vals)))
p_vals

# Pseudo-R² (McFadden)
pR2(model)

# Nullmodell ohne residuals_score
model_null <- multinom(
  sexual_orientation ~ 
    pc1 + pc2 + pc3 + pc4 + pc5 + pc6 +
    batch,
  data = merged_same_sex_so
)

# Likelihood-Ratio-Test
lrtest(model, model_null)

```


```{r plot residuen depression}
dep_gender <- ggplot(merged_dep_g, aes(x = residuals_score, fill = gender)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
facet_wrap(~ gender, nrow = 6) + 
  labs(
    title = "Depression",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Density",
    fill = "Gender"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()+
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-2e-6, 2e-6), ylim = c(0, 2000000)) +  #  Achsen begrenzen
  theme(legend.position = "none")+
     theme(
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 20),   # Titel zentrieren
    strip.text = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 13)    # Facet-Titel zentrieren
     )

dep_gender
```

```{r plot residuen ptsd}
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
facet_wrap(~ sexual_orientation, nrow = 6) + 
  labs(
    title = "Schizophrenia",
    x = "",
    y = "",
    fill = "Sexual Orientation"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()+
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-2e-6, 2e-6), ylim = c(0, 2000000)) +  #  Achsen begrenzen
  theme(legend.position = "none")+
     theme(
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    #axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 20),   # Titel zentrieren
    strip.text = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 13)    # Facet-Titel zentrieren
  )

scz_sexual_orientation
```
